source_caption_text:
Never forget when Gucci Mane got mad because Keyshia Ka’oir wanted him to eat fruit and all he wanted was a cheeseburger 😭😂🍔

Keyshia was trying to keep him on track with his healthier eating habits, but Gucci wasn’t feeling the fruit bowl. The moment got even funnier when Mike WiLL Made-It later pulled up with food 😂

Behind the funny moment was a major lifestyle change. By his 2016 release from prison, Gucci had lost around 75 pounds. He later explained that changing his diet, exercising regularly and getting sober were key parts of his transformation, according to his Vogue interview⁠￼.

Gucci put in the work, but that day he just wanted his burger 😭
